answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the violet of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Work waits on the mesa until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the canyon of the next round. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work.
